name: ADL-5859
summary: ADL-5859, also known as compound 20, is an opioid drug that is selective for the δ-opioid receptor, it is being investigated as an alternative to traditional opioids in pain management.

pharmacology.text: Like all opioid drugs, ADL-5859 activates opioid receptors, but where as traditional opioids (such as oxycodone) activate the three main receptors (mu, delta, and kappa), ADL-5859 appears to be selective and only activates the delta receptor. with a Ki of 20 nM.

uses.text: ADL-5859, also known as compound 20, is an opioid drug that is selective for the δ-opioid receptor, it is being investigated as an alternative to traditional opioids in pain management.

summaryZh: ADL-5859（也稱作化合物20，英語：compound 20）是一種含氮有機化合物，分子式C24H28N2O3，可用作δ-阿片受體的選擇性激動劑。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs acting on the δ-opioid receptor have been linked to seizures in animal studies. Its effects and risks in people have not been well established.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。在動物研究中，作用於δ鴉片受體的藥物曾與癲癇發作有關。它在人體的作用與風險尚未充分確立。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。在动物研究中，作用于δ鸦片受体的药物曾与癫痫发作有关。它在人体的作用与风险尚未充分确立。

fact.en: It picks out the δ-opioid receptor, which was being explored because, unlike the μ receptor, it is not thought to slow breathing in the same way.
fact.zh: 它專門作用於δ鴉片受體；研究這個受體的原因是，與μ受體不同，一般認為它不會以同樣的方式使呼吸變慢。
fact.zhHans: 它专门作用于δ鸦片受体；研究这个受体的原因是，与μ受体不同，一般认为它不会以同样的方式使呼吸变慢。
